name: weekly-vendor-audit
prompt: Run business/sops/ops/renewal-review.md. Pull the Notion 'Vendors' database, compute days-to-renewal and cost trend per vendor, and post the three flag categories (renewing < 30d, cost increase > 10%, unused > 30d) to #ops. Each flagged item needs a one-line recommendation. The founder reacts with :renew:, :cancel:, or :downgrade: to drive next step.
